sentence_stem: If she had taken the job offer,
correct_completion: she would be living abroad now.
full_sentence: If she had taken the job offer, she would be living abroad now.
acceptable_variants: she would have more options today.
she would probably be in another country now.

options.text: she will be living abroad next year.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future plan, but the stem is an unreal past condition, so the result needs 'would' with a present time reference.
The present simple describes a fact and does not express an unreal result that depends on the past condition.

options.text: she would be living abroad now.

options.why_wrong: 'Was ... yesterday' places the result in the past, but the result must refer to the present.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past unreal condition with present unreal result
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition in the if-clause with an unreal present result in the main clause. Ukrainian speakers may mix up the time references here, because Ukrainian marks conditions with a mood form that does not separate past and present in the same way English tenses do.
